summary: Backend-only validation for the UC-00508 (Trend Micro Apex Central / Behavior Monitoring / New startup program) fix on offense 0d75ac25-9714-4f42-a854-03af415d43ff. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_16.py which logs in as admin, POSTs /api/offenses/{id}/investigate, immediately GETs /api/offenses/{id} (rule-engine base), then polls up to ~160s for ai_analysis.llm_status in {done,failed}, and asserts grounded content in BOTH states. ALL assertions PASS in ~48-54s across two consecutive runs. Verified: (a) Analysis mentions the registry autorun key HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Figma Agent, the file 'figma_agent.exe', host 'LTWGSLVAP1424', and device action 'Assess'; (b) Impact section is non-empty, mentions startup/autorun/persistence AND explicitly states 'no evidence of confirmed compromise/infection'; (c) Recommendations include >=3 items covering: verify legitimacy of figma_agent.exe, review startup/registry autorun/scheduled tasks, run full AV/EDR scan on the endpoint, and remove/delete the persistence mechanism if malicious; (d) No prompt/meta echo leakage ('We need to output', 'each starting with', 'REASON:', 'Must mention actual IP', 'ANALYSIS section', '<one technical sentence>', literal '<...>' placeholders); (e) No 'user None' / "user 'None'" text; (f) Grounded content survives regardless of final llm_status (done or failed).
critical_code_review_comments: soc_engine._parse_payload_kv now correctly extracts Trend Micro Apex Central CEF fields (sproc/file, TMCMLogTarget/registry autorun, shost/host, act/action, and csNLabel pairs Rule_Name/Operation/Risk_Level/Event_Type) and _generate_analysis_lines' malware/behavior-monitoring/persistence branch weaves them into a single grounded sentence.

_generate_impact_lines produces the required non-empty impact narrative including 'persistence via HKCU...Run key' AND the 'no evidence of confirmed compromise/infection' qualifier when action=='Assess' (i.e., detection-only, not blocked).
_generate_recommendations persistence branch returns the 4 required actions grounded on figma_agent.exe and the Run key; count is within the 3-6 window expected by MSSP conventions.
'user None' rendering bug is fixed — analysis text for this offense (which has no username) does not include the placeholder string.

Grounded artifacts are produced by the deterministic base and therefore survive whether the background OpenRouter free-tier LLM returns 'done' or 'failed'/rate-limited — matches the design invariant in the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UC-00508 (Trend Micro Apex Central / Behavior Monitoring / Persistence) fix is validated and stable. test_iteration_16.py can be reused as a regression: it triggers investigate, checks immediate rule-engine base AND the final polled state for grounded artifacts. Note: the backend emits the registry key with escaped backslashes ('HKCU\\Software\\...') in the JSON string so the test normalizes \\ -> \ before comparing. Login timeout should be >=60s (bcrypt is slow on the preview host). One investigate call per run.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a green-path validation of a fix, no bug found. Fix (main agent) works: soc_engine._parse_payload_kv extracts CEF Apex Central artifacts, _generate_analysis_lines/_generate_impact_lines/_generate_recommendations weave them into a grounded, persistence-aware narrative, and llm_engine preserves the deterministic base when the OpenRouter LLM returns empty/echo/failed.
